Dr. Juan Garcia

Senior Researcher

Return to archive↗

This is an inherited source-site record. Membership, biography, affiliations, and publication details have not been confirmed as BIOracle information.

Biography as supplied.

Dr. Garcia specializes in the evolutionary dynamics of bacterial kill-switches and safety mechanisms in synthetic biology. His research combines stochastic modeling with experimental validation to predict and prevent evolutionary escape from biocontainment systems.

Areas of expertise

Kill-Switch Evolution · Population Dynamics · Stochastic Processes

Education as supplied

  • PhD in Computational Biology · MIT · 2012
  • MSc in Applied Mathematics · TU Munich · 2008
  • BSc in Physics · Heidelberg University · 2006

Research interests

  • Kill-switch robustness
  • Mutation-selection balance
  • Synthetic circuit evolution
  • Biocontainment failure modes

Publication records as supplied

  • Evolutionary pathways to kill-switch failure in synthetic bacteria · Science Advances · 2024
  • Population dynamics of engineered microorganisms under selection · Nature Communications · 2023
